entries.input: Let $T$ be a linear operator on $\mathbb{R}^n$ and $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ any set. Then the Lebesgue measure of $T(\Omega)$ is $|\det T|$ times the Lebesgue measure of $\Omega$.
entries.name: VolumeScalesByDet
entries.binders: (n : ℕ) (T : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) (Ω : Set (Fin n → ℝ))
entries.conclusion: MeasureTheory.volume (T '' Ω) = ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det T| * MeasureTheory.volume Ω

entries.input: Let $a, b, c > 0$. The solid ellipsoid $\{(x, y, z) \in \mathbb{R}^3 : x^2/a^2 + y^2/b^2 + z^2/c^2 < 1\}$ has volume $\tfrac{4}{3} \pi a b c$.
entries.name: EllipsoidVolume
entries.binders: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
entries.conclusion: MeasureTheory.volume {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) | (p 0) ^ 2 / a ^ 2 + (p 1) ^ 2 / b ^ 2 + (p 2) ^ 2 / c ^ 2 < 1} = ENNReal.ofReal (4 / 3 * Real.pi * a * b * c)
